Update item names, descriptions, prices, modifiers, option limits, photos, and availability using approved information. Confirm the correct brand, location, and platform before editing. Organization and follow through Maintain a clear tracker of requests, affected menus, deadlines, approvals, and completion status. Keep source files and change records organized so no location or platform is missed. Use checklists to manage multiple updates at once. Ask focused questions when information is missing or conflicting, and communicate blockers before they delay completion. Flag errors promptly, correct them, and update the checking process to prevent recurrence. Improve repetitive workflows while retaining accuracy checks. Launches and marketplace support Set up menus for new brands and locations, track launch progress, and complete menu checks before go-live.
